command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/stage
printf '%s  sesame-cache.sh\n' 1380c3ed0279476b6ebd0e6aadbd7daaaed73251615c3e29b7edab9c7e166174 > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: sesame-cache.sh does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
bash /tmp/sesame-cache.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/stage/sesame-cache.log
exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
